DiscountApplied.description: One discount contribution to a Price.

discountAmount.description: Absolute amount subtracted by this discount.

discountId.description: Identifier of the discount rule that produced this contribution.

discountRate.description: Rate of this discount, as a decimal fraction.

discountedGrossPrice.description: Gross price after this discount was applied.

discountedNetPrice.description: Net price after this discount was applied.

grossPrice.description: Gross price before this discount was applied.

grossPriceDiscountAmount.description: Amount subtracted from the gross price by this contribution.

netPrice.description: Net price before this discount was applied.

netPriceDiscountAmount.description: Amount subtracted from the net price by this contribution.

vatDiscountAmount.description: VAT amount corresponding to this discount contribution.

DiscountPlan.description: Discount plan applied on the subscription's acquisition and future renewals. A plan is a named sequence of steps; startingStep marks where that sequence started. A current step is calculated as a sum of the startingStep and the generation of the subscription.

nextDiscountStep.description: Preview of the step that will be applied on the next renewal (not persisted).

startingStep.description: Index of the initial step. It is not incremented on each renewal.

tag.description: Discount plan tag identifying the pricing schedule.

DiscountedPrice.description: Discount summary for a Price. Contains the discounted net/gross amounts and the full list of individual discounts that were applied.

allDiscountsApplied.description: Breakdown of every discount applied to this price.

cumulatedDiscountRate.description: Combined rate of all stacked discounts, as a decimal fraction.

discountLabel.description: Human-readable label of the winning discount.

discountRate.description: Effective rate of the winning discount, as a decimal fraction (0.24 = 24%).

discountTestOrder.description: True when the discount was applied for test/order-preview purposes and should not be reported to accounting.

grossPriceDiscountAmount.description: Amount saved on the gross price.

netPriceDiscountAmount.description: Amount saved on the net price.

vatDiscountAmount.description: VAT amount corresponding to the discount.

Email.description: Record of an email sent to the end user for this subscription.

date.description: Timestamp at which the email was queued for delivery.

emailId.description: Identifier assigned by the mail service after the email was accepted.

id.description: Local identifier of the email entry.

message.description: Optional free-form message attached to the email.

templateName.description: Template used to render the email.

Lifecycle.description: Runtime state of a subscription: status, key dates and identifiers of the driving billing engine.

anniversaryDate.description: Date until which the subscription is paid — same value as `expirationDate` (Unix ms).

creationDate.description: Timestamp at which the subscription was created (Unix ms).

expirationDate.description: Date until which the subscription is paid — same value as `anniversaryDate` (Unix ms).

firstChargeAttemptDate.description: Timestamp of the first charge attempt in the current billing cycle (Unix ms).

generation.description: Number of times the subscription has been renewed. `-1` during the trial period, `0` during the first paid term, incremented on each renewal thereafter.

id.description: Legacy subscription-engine v1 identifier. Deprecated: no active subscription runs on the v1 engine — retained only on historical, terminated records.

modelId.description: Identifier of the subscription model currently driving the lifecycle.

nextBillingDate.description: Timestamp of the next scheduled billing attempt (Unix ms).

paymentDeadline.description: Deadline by which the current renewal payment must succeed before the subscription enters Dunning/Expired (Unix ms).

prebillingDate.description: Next prebilling date — timestamp at which the prebilling order for the next renewal will be created (Unix ms).

subEngineId.description: Subscription-engine v2 identifier. Always set for active and newly created subscriptions.

Price.description: Price returned by the renewal-price endpoint: net/gross amounts, VAT breakdown, currency, and any discount applied.

currency.description: ISO-4217 currency of the amounts above.

discountedPrice.description: Discount details when a discount is applied on top of the base price.

orderId.description: Identifier of the pre-billing order the price was read from, when applicable.

vatAmount.description: Absolute VAT amount for this price.

vatAmountMsrp.description: VAT amount for the manufacturer's suggested retail price (MSRP).

vatIncluded.description: True if the gross amounts already include VAT.

vatRate.description: VAT rate as a decimal fraction (0.20 = 20%).

Product.description: A product covered by the subscription and, on upgrade, the product to switch to.

dynamicVariables.description: Product-level variables forwarded to the pricing engine and used by dynamic pricing rules.

licenseId.description: License identifier associated with the product, if any.

lineItemId.description: Identifier of the line item in the initial order that provisioned this product.

modelId.description: On upgrade requests, the target subscription model to switch to. Only honoured when different from the current modelId.

previousLineItemId.description: Line item identifier from the previous generation. Set after an upgrade to correlate the new product with the one it replaced.

priceFunctionParameters.description: Parameters passed to price-function evaluation at renewal.

ReactivateRequest.description: Options for reactivating a subscription. Optional — an empty body reactivates with default behaviour (email is sent).

skipSendingReactivationEmail.description: When true, no reactivation email is sent to the end user. Defaults to false.

Subscription.description: A subscription owned by an end user for a set of products, driven by a subscription model that dictates its billing term.

billingAddressId.description: Identifier of the end user billing address for this subscription.

discountPlan.description: Discount plan applied on renewals, if any.

emails.description: Emails sent for this subscription (welcome, renewal, cancellation…).

externalContext.description: Opaque JSON payload carried from the storefront; decoded into decodedExternalContext.

externalRefId.description: Partner-provided reference id used to correlate this subscription with an external system.

imported.description: True when the subscription was imported from an external system instead of being created via checkout.

initialOrderId.description: Identifier of the order that created the subscription.

layout.description: Layout code used to render the subscription in the storefront.

lifecycle.description: Current lifecycle state: dates, status and engine identifiers.

mandateValue.description: Mandate value for recurring payments, in the subscription currency.

migratedFromCustomerId.description: Original customer id when the subscription was migrated from another customer.

model.description: Subscription model resolved from modelId (populated on read, not persisted).

modelId.description: Identifier of the subscription model that drives the billing schedule.

name.description: Human-readable name of the subscription (usually the product name).

nextProducts.description: Products that will replace the current products at the next renewal (populated during upgrade).

paymentMethodIsNoLongerReplayable.description: True when the stored payment method cannot be replayed for further charges.

paymentMethodIsNoLongerReplayableReason.description: Reason returned by the payment provider when the payment method is no longer replayable.

products.description: Products currently covered by the subscription.

remotePriceParameters.description: Parameters forwarded to the remote pricing engine to fetch the price of the next renewal order.

source.description: Origin of the subscription (e.g. Nexway, partner code); not persisted.

storeId.description: Identifier of the store that owns this subscription.

subscriptionSuspendedUponEndUserDeletion.description: True if the subscription was suspended because the owning end user was deleted.

upgradable.description: True if the subscription may be upgraded to another plan.

SubscriptionModel.description: Defines the schedule that drives a subscription: billing term, prebilling timing and charge-attempt cadence.

customerId.description: Identifier of the customer this model belongs to.

durationUntilTrialEnd.description: Number of days between the subscription start and the end of the trial period. Absent when the model has no trial.

Term.description: Billing term expressed as a duration (value + unit).

UpgradeRequest.description: Body of the /subscriptions/{id}/upgrade call. Set `lifecycle.expirationDate` to a Unix timestamp (milliseconds) strictly later than the current expiration date to extend the subscription.

lifecycle.description: Lifecycle overrides. Set `expirationDate` to a Unix timestamp (milliseconds) strictly later than the current expiration date to extend the subscription.

get.description: Paged listing of subscription models visible to the caller.
Return the subscription model identified by its id, including billing term and trial duration.

post.description: Move the subscription to the terminal Canceled state via the billing engine. Emits a canceled event and sends the cancellation email to the end user unless skipEmail is set.

parameters.description: If true, no cancellation email is sent to the end user.
parameters.name: skipEmail

post.description: Resume a suspended or canceled subscription. By default the end user receives a reactivation email; set skipSendingReactivationEmail to disable it.

get.description: Return the price that will be charged on the next renewal, including VAT breakdown and any applicable discount. Prefers the price of an existing pre-billing order when available, otherwise recomputes it from the next-generation products. Only allowed when the subscription is in Active, Dunning, Suspended, Trial or TrialConversion state; other statuses return 400.

post.description: Set or replace the discount plan applied on future renewals. Providing an empty body clears the current plan.
post.summary: Attach a discount plan to a subscription

post.description: Pause billing and product entitlement. Rejected when the subscription is already in a terminal state (Canceled or Expired). Emits a suspended event; a suspension email is sent to the end user unless the request is flagged as partner-initiated. The subscription can be resumed later via the reactivate endpoint.

parameters.description: Flag the suspension as initiated by a partner (only honoured for internal/customer/nexway callers).
parameters.name: byPartner

post.description:
Extend the expiration date of an active subscription to give the end user additional time. Typical use cases include customer-service scenarios, promotional extensions, and other business needs. The new `expirationDate` must be later than the current one and expressed as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds. Only works for active subscriptions — cannot be applied to expired or canceled ones.

To update the product a subscription will renew with, use `POST /purchases/{subscriptionId}` instead.

tags.description: Manage the lifecycle of a subscription — create, read, upgrade, suspend, reactivate, cancel and renew.
tags.name: Subscription

tags.description: Read the subscription models (billing term, trial duration, associated customer) referenced by subscriptions.
tags.name: Subscription Model
